Subject: Ridgefield community open house this Saturday

Hi,

We're hosting an open house at 142 Ashgrove Lane in Maple Creek on Saturday, October 17 from 1–3 pm—in the heart of the neighborhood many of your Saturday meetup runners explore.

We've followed your posts about local routes and community events like the Harvest Lane 10K, and we thought the Ridgefield running community would want to know about this home.

If you'd like to share it with your followers, we'd love that. Please label any post as a paid partnership.
